module: Jbeam post-processing step that loads the *.interaction.json files (folder /vehicles/common/ then the vehicle folder) and merges their interaction groups, action categories and actions. Produces vehicle.interactionGroups, vehicle.actionCategories and vehicle.inputActions, used afterwards by the input actions system (lua/ge/extensions/core/input/actions.lua according to the code comment).
notes: Only files whose fileversion is 2 are accepted; the others are ignored with an error in the log.
Each action receives a field source = name of the file that defines it.
The merge is done with tableMerge: the vehicle file, read last, overrides the common definitions.
vehicle.components.actionIconOverrides (table actionName -> icon) replaces the icon of existing actions.
The module only runs where FS (file system) is available.

process.desc: Reads the interaction files, applies the icon overrides and stores the results in vehicle.interactionGroups, vehicle.actionCategories and vehicle.inputActions.

vehicle.desc: Vehicle data (vehicleDirectory required; modified in place).
